text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After wrapping up a productive summer 
training camp, Tanino Gimlet was 
interviewed by reporters the moment she 
returned to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Your classmate and rival Symboli Kris S 
will also be running in your next race, 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! Please, tell us 
your thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...In your eyes, when was my greatest 
race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...The "Japanese Derby", perhaps? No, 
the "Yasuda Kinen" was deeply moving as 
well, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I'll show you 
a level of fervor that far surpasses that.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, feast your eyes! Upon the descent of 
the "God of Destruction," who will 
revolutionize the entire world you see!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The promised time is drawing near―――

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, T-Tanino Gimlet-san!! Please talk to 
me a little more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer came to an end... and the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) was drawing near.
